WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(round) AS avg_round
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT ca.circuitId,
       ca.country,
       ca.avg_round AS circuit_avg_round,
       ca.avg_round - coa.avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS coa ON coa.country = ca.country
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
